title: WorkProductManifest
description: Every file a pack CLAIMS to have written, with hashes. The kernel compares the claim against the workspace: a file on disk that is not declared here is an undeclared write and fails the run, and a declared file whose hash does not match is a tampered or stale claim. Requiring the manifest rather than scanning the directory is deliberate - it makes the pack state its output, so 'what did you produce' has an answer that can be wrong.

artifacts.description: Paths are relative to the capsule workspace root. An absolute path or any traversal segment is rejected before the hash is even checked.

truncated.description: True when the pack stopped listing because it hit its declared max_files. Named rather than silently short, because a quietly truncated manifest reads as a complete one.
